method: Compare the accepted native-page convention with source P0 locations and a Yale image derivative. Source counts and P0 texts were read before the image; the scan was previously exposed in project inventories. This is not a blinded or independent concordance test.

naming_reference.scope: The source names f68r1, f68r2 and f68r3, treats plain f68r as a foldout placeholder, and defines recto ordering away from the binding. It does not verify individual image glyph sequences.

pages.proposed_field: Left field of the displayed scan, closest to the visible binding.
direct_observations: The upper writing has three longer horizontal rows and a short row near the left below them.
A small circular drawing occupies part of the space near the lower upper-text rows; star-like forms and short writing fill the field below.
pages.placement_hypothesis: Locations 1-4 correspond to the upper writing in source order; location 3's drawing-interruption marker may correspond to the row divided by the upper circular drawing.

pages.proposed_field: Middle field of the displayed scan, between the left writing field and the large circular drawing at right.
direct_observations: Five horizontal writing rows appear above and alongside a small upper circular drawing.
Star-like forms and short writing are scattered below, with another small circular drawing near the foot.
pages.placement_hypothesis: Locations 1-5 correspond to the upper writing in source order; location 5's drawing-interruption marker may correspond to writing divided around the small upper drawing.

pages.proposed_field: Right field containing the large circular drawing.
direct_observations: The circular drawing includes a central face-like form, star-like forms in sectors, and writing along circular and radial paths.
A visible vertical crease crosses the drawing; the proposed native page is not assigned a boundary at that crease.
pages.placement_hypothesis: No P0 row assignment is proposed for this page. Its present non-P0 records require a separate image-region review.

review_tests: Compare the nine proposed P0 locations with original-resolution image rows, preserving source order, uncertain spaces, alternatives and drawing interruptions.
Reject a placement if glyph sequences or drawing-interruption positions disagree; matching row counts alone is insufficient.
Keep f68r3's present page and non-P0 writing explicit. Do not invent P0 rows, call the page blank, or split the circular drawing into equal-width crops or independent samples.
limits: No exact pixel region, panel mask, physical-line reconstruction, verified glyph reading, decoding or translation is assigned.
Native page names and visible creases need not define the same units.
The three native pages share one leaf and one canvas; they are not independent image samples.
This is exposed source/image material, not an untouched evaluation set.
